source: GitHub (MiSTer-devel/GBA_MiSTer issue #138, 'Question about converting save files containing RTC data')
author: RobertPeip (author of the GBA_MiSTer core)
licence: none stated (a file attached to a public GitHub issue)
what_it_is: A German Pokemon Emerald save the core's author attached to show where GBA_MiSTer puts the clock: 128 KiB of flash followed by the core's 512-byte RTC block (0x20200 bytes in all). Game progress unknown; the zip entry is dated 2020-05-14.
note: Not in the 1G1R ROM set here (it carries the USA/Europe Emerald), so it was not booted. The 512 bytes after 0x20000 are 32 copies of one 16-byte record, as clocks.json's gba-mister entry (packed, reserved 512, timestamp 4) describes.
